name: # --- movement (yards and seconds); PLACEHOLDER until calibrated (Edition 8.48)
vmax_base
note: top speed at SPD 0

name: vmax_per_spd
note: top speed per point of SPD

name: acc_base
note: acceleration yd/s2 at ACC 0

name: acc_per_acc
note: acceleration per point of ACC

name: agi_acc_gain
note: share by which AGI scales acceleration (0.25 = +-12 percent over 50 points)

name: dec_mult
note: deceleration over acceleration

name: backpedal
note: share of top speed moving backwards or sideways in coverage

name: sep_radius
note: players closer than this and not engaged are pushed apart

name: sep_push
note: push speed yd/s

name: eng_range
note: distance at which a blocker and her man are engaged

name: eng_gain_run
note: leverage per second per 30 points of rating difference (run)

name: eng_gain_pass
note: leverage per second per 30 points of rating difference (pass)

name: eng_noise
note: leverage noise per sqrt(second)

name: eng_win
note: leverage at which the engagement is decided

name: eng_drive_run
note: yd/s the pair is driven at full leverage in a run block

name: eng_back_pass
note: yd/s the pocket gives at full negative leverage

name: eng_size
note: rating points per kg of weight above 80 kg

name: eng_shed_stun
note: seconds a beaten blocker stays stunned

name: eng_double_gain
note: share of a second blocker's rating added to a double team

name: carry_horizon
note: seconds a carrier looks ahead

name: carry_hold
note: leverage a carrier needs to change heading

name: tackle_reach
note: reach of a tackler yd

name: tackle_base
note: tackle probability at equal rating

name: tackle_gain
note: per point of tackling minus carrier elusiveness

name: tackle_speed
note: per yd/s of closing speed

name: tackle_gang
note: added per extra tackler

name: tackle_miss_stun
note: seconds a defender who missed is out

name: tackle_miss_slow
note: carrier speed multiplier after breaking a tackle

name: fall_forward
note: yards a carrier gains after first contact at equal strength

name: fumble_base
note: fumble chance per tackle

name: ball_speed_base
note: horizontal ball speed yd/s at THP 0

name: ball_speed_per_thp
note: per point of THP

name: release_delay
note: seconds from decision to release

name: acc_err_base
note: aim error sd yd (near)

name: acc_err_dist
note: aim error sd per yd of throw

name: acc_err_tha
note: aim error scales as (1.9 - this*THA)

name: acc_err_press
note: added share of error under pressure

name: catch_radius
note: reach radius for a catch yd

name: catch_height
note: highest ball a player can reach yd

name: open_margin
note: yards of separation a quarterback needs by default

name: prog_dt
note: seconds per step of the quarterback's progression

name: qb_perception
note: sd of the quarterback's error in judging separation (scaled by awareness)

name: pocket_time
note: seconds before the quarterback leaves the pocket

name: sack_prob
note: chance a rusher in reach brings down the quarterback
